model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the relationship between the number of completions and coverage across four distinct model configurations. The x-axis is labeled "Number of completions ($k$)" and utilizes a base-2 logarithmic scale, with values ranging from $2^0$ to $2^8$ marked at sequential power-of-two intervals. The y-axis is labeled "Coverage" and employs a linear scale, displaying tick marks at intervals of 0.2 with a visible numeric range from 0.4 to 0.8. The plot features four lines. The "Llama-3B" configuration is represented by a solid dark blue line with circle markers, showing a steady increase from a coverage value of approximately 0.43 at $2^0$ to roughly 0.91 at $2^8$. The "Llama-3B + FT" configuration is depicted by a dotted dark green line with upward-pointing triangle markers, which demonstrates a continuous upward trend, beginning at about 0.43 at $2^0$ and ending near 0.91 at $2^8$. The "Llama-1B" configuration is shown as a solid light blue line with circle markers, smoothly climbing from an initial value of approximately 0.25 at $2^0$ to about 0.86 at $2^8$. Finally, the "Llama-1B + FT" configuration is plotted as a dotted light green line with upward-pointing triangle markers, tracking a steady rise from roughly 0.25 at $2^0$ to approximately 0.86 at $2^8$.
